content: Shangla Top is located at 2800 meters altitude. It is the main pass connecting Swat with Indus valley. The views from Shangla Top are breathtaking. You can see snow-capped peaks, deep valleys, and winding rivers.
Achar Top is 300 meters above Shangla Top. Take the link road from Shangla Top check post. 45 minutes drive. 15 km distance. 360 degree views. Less crowded than Shangla Top. 4x4 recommended.
Shangla Top check post is where security personnel are stationed. All visitors are registered here. Link road to Achar Top starts from this check post. Local guides available here.
